title: feat: Add Thermal Throttling Logic
body:
This pull request introduces a new thermal throttling feature to prevent the charging station from overheating during prolonged use. The new `PowerManagement` module monitors the temperature of the main processor and the charging controller. If the temperature exceeds the configured threshold, the charging power is reduced by 50%.

This change addresses the issue of unexpected shutdowns reported in JIRA ticket CO-119.

comments.body: Looks good overall. Have you tested this with the new payment terminal hardware? We've seen some issues with power draw on that model.
Good point. I've run the tests on the new hardware, and the power draw is within acceptable limits. I've added the test results to the JIRA ticket.

commit.message: test: add unit tests for PowerManagement module
docs: update documentation for thermal management
